mentions.name: Website Roasters
mentions.description: A conversion tool that analyzes a website's landing page and produces a prioritized plan for making the value proposition clearer to new users.
mentions.problem: Landing pages often fail to communicate their value proposition clearly to new users.
mentions.source_excerpt: I ran your landing page through a conversion tool I'm working on. It gives a prioritized plan on how to make the value prop even clearer for new users.

evidence.value: I ran your landing page through a conversion tool I'm working on. It gives a prioritized plan on how to make the value prop even clearer for new users.
